summary.text: Cindi Clayton is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Jim Tomes.
An instructor and board chair of Holly's House, she says she wants to bring her focus on children's well-being to the Statehouse.

paragraphs.text: Cindi Clayton graduated from Union High School and earned a graduate degree from the University of Southern Indiana in 2014.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been a public servant for 20 years, working in human resources and then teaching full-time.
She said she has served Holly's House, which provides services to children and families experiencing abuse, for 11 years and is currently its board chair.
Clayton listed lowering utility costs, restoring funding to public schools and representing district residents with transparency and respect as her key messages.
